description: This file defines a Spring Data JPA repository interface for managing CalendarInstance entities in the Apache Fineract project. It includes method declarations for querying calendar instances based on various criteria, with caching annotations for performance optimization.

classes.name: CalendarInstanceRepository
classes.description: Spring Data JPA repository interface for CalendarInstance entity, providing methods for retrieval and cache management.

methods.name: findByEntityIdAndEntityTypeIdAndCalendarTypeId

methods.name: findCalendarInstancesForLoansByGroupIdAndClientIdAndStatuses
methods.description: Fetches calendar instances for loans associated with specific group and client IDs and loan statuses, with caching.

methods.name: countOfLoansSyncedWithCalendar
